question.text: Trolley X (mass 2.0 kg) moves to the right at 3.0 m/s. Trolley Y (mass 1.0 kg) moves to the left at 1.5 m/s. They collide head-on and stick together.

marking.final_answer: (a) 4.5 kg m/s (b) 1.5 m/s to the right (c) not conserved: 10.1 J before, 3.4 J after

explicit: momentum to the right is positive

candidates.change_summary: Head-on collision requires a sign convention and an evaluation of energy conservation instead of a direct energy-loss calculation.
